description: Permanently remove a saved selector hint from the hints file, e.g. when the site changed and the selector no longer works. This cannot be undone; save a corrected hint with selector_hint_save. Fails if no hint with that key exists for the domain.

domain.description: Site hostname, e.g. 'www.saucedemo.com'. Defaults to the hostname of the page currently open.

key.description: Short name for the element, e.g. 'login_button' or 'search_box' (1-128 chars).

name: selector_hint_delete
